trans-unit.source: We need to assemble the Sword of Time, and fast...

trans-unit.source: Say, why's that thing so important, anyway?

trans-unit.source: Dhaos would just flee to another time if we confront him without it.

trans-unit.source: Yeah. We're short of any other means of preventing that.

trans-unit.source: Hopelessly behind as usual. Hmhm, sucks-to-be-you!
